column1: # Curated GGUF catalog for llama.cpp. Resource figures are practical planning estimates, not guarantees.

column17: notes
notes
Fast small model; Q4_0 can use GGML online CPU repacking. Vision requires a matching projection file when supplied by the repository.
Recommended tiny general model and default service choice; text works without an mmproj.
Stronger compact assistant for modest desktops and laptops.
Balanced modern assistant; lower context sizes reduce KV-cache memory substantially.
Higher-quality model for 16 GiB-class systems; use partial GPU offload if VRAM is limited.
Very small multilingual reasoning/chat model.
Good low-resource reasoning model.
Practical quality/speed balance for an average computer.
Strong local reasoning and multilingual chat model.
Demanding dense model; 24-32 GiB RAM or substantial VRAM is recommended.
MoE model with about 3.3B active parameters but all expert weights must fit RAM/VRAM.
Compact English-centric instruction model; review Meta's license before redistribution.
Reliable small assistant with broad tooling support.
Established general-purpose 8B assistant; review Meta's license.
Small text-only Gemma model; review Google's Gemma terms.
Excellent compact multimodal assistant; download mmproj for image input.
High-quality multimodal model for larger desktops; mmproj adds memory and disk usage.
Compact Microsoft instruction model with strong code and reasoning behavior.
High-quality dense model; context and KV cache can push total memory well beyond the weight file.
Fast, established instruction model with broad language support.
Large-vocabulary multilingual 12B model.
Small reasoning-focused distilled checkpoint; answers can be verbose.
Good local reasoning option for 16 GiB systems.
Higher-quality reasoning model with substantial memory requirements.
Small code-completion and instruction model.
Strong coding assistant suitable for an average 16 GiB desktop.
Compact IBM instruction model with enterprise-friendly licensing.
Larger Granite instruction model for chat and code.
Efficient small English model for low-resource systems.
MoE model with roughly 3.6B active parameters; all weights still consume RAM or VRAM.
Embedding model; run llama-server with embedding endpoints rather than chat prompting.
Compact text embedding model; not a chat model.
Very small English embedding model; not a chat model.
